title: Exclude unpainted
notes: transparent glyphs from visible-copy and typography rules.
result: A shared paint classifier protects undersized-text, ascii-ellipsis, bare-url and type-scale-sprawl without removing probe geometry or exempting a CSS class. Opaque, clipped-background, shadow-painted and unknown-color controls retain conservative checks.
evidence: The undersized-text regression and three remaining rule regressions failed before their fixes. `pnpm --filter @syntopica/ui-quality exec vitest run tests/rules/pdfSelectionText.test.ts tests/rules/undersizedText.paint.test.ts tests/rules/typography.test.ts tests/rules/typeScaleSprawl.test.ts tests/rules/copy.test.ts tests/rules/newRules.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passed 37 tests in six files. Independent review returned no findings. Official PDF.js text_layer_builder.css declares selection spans transparent; no production PDF or consumer deployment was tested.
